purpose: Allow provider credentials to be bound by stable secret reference without placing credential values in source, queue payloads, receipts or chat.
prohibited: literal credential values in spreadsheet queues
provider promotion from configuration presence alone
route_precedence: reuse verified Google Cloud secret reference after authenticated admin recovery
reuse a verified Apps Script script-property reference when the executing project is current and the property resolver is live
reuse an authorised private-runtime environment alias
hold provider execution when no secret-reference resolver is currently callable
truth_boundary: This contract proves only source-side secret-reference handling. It does not prove that a provider credential exists, is valid, has usable balance, is bound to a runtime, or has executed a provider request.
